name: B10-0394/2025 (S&D) – Case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling for action. It asks Rwanda to release Victoire Ingabire and other opposition members held on what it calls politically motivated charges. It also urges Rwanda to stop harassing opponents and journalists, to let opposition parties register and take part in elections, and to hold free and fair elections. Finally, it asks the European Union to watch the trials closely and to review its support for Rwanda if things do not improve.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- Affects Rwanda's government, opposition members, journalists and civil society.
- Next: the text goes to the EU Council, Commission and Rwanda's government.
